+"""V1 snapshot and project endpoints.
+
+GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}                           – project + snapshots
+GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}   – snapshot metadata
+GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/files – paginated inventory
+GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/source/{file_id} – bounded source
+GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/capabilities     – capability report
+GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/graph            – structural graph
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, status
+
+from app.models.v1.graph import Graph
+from app.models.v1.snapshot import FilePage, Project, Snapshot
+from app.models.v1.source import CapabilityReport, SourceSlice
+from app.services.graph_service import build_structural_graph
+from app.services.snapshot_service import (
+    SnapshotNotFoundError,
+    build_capability_report,
+    get_inventory,
+    get_project_snapshots,
+    get_snapshot,
+    read_source_lines,
+)
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/projects", tags=["v1-snapshots"])
+
+
+def _404(detail: str) -> HTTPException:
+    return HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=detail)
+
+
+@router.get("/{project_id}/snapshots", response_model=list[Snapshot])
+def list_snapshots(project_id: str) -> list[Snapshot]:
+    return get_project_snapshots(project_id)
+
+
+@router.get("/{project_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}", response_model=Snapshot)
+def read_snapshot(project_id: str, snapshot_id: str) -> Snapshot:
+    try:
+        snap = get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except SnapshotNotFoundError as e:
+        raise _404(str(e)) from e
+    if snap.project_id != project_id:
+        raise _404("Snapshot not found.")
+    return snap
+
+
+@router.get(
+    "/{project_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/files",
+    response_model=FilePage,
+)
+def read_inventory(
+    project_id: str,
+    snapshot_id: str,
+    cursor: str | None = Query(default=None),
+    limit: int = Query(default=500, ge=1, le=2000),
+) -> FilePage:
+    try:
+        snap = get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except SnapshotNotFoundError as e:
+        raise _404(str(e)) from e
+    if snap.project_id != project_id:
+        raise _404("Snapshot not found.")
+    try:
+        return get_inventory(snapshot_id, cursor=cursor, limit=limit)
+    except SnapshotNotFoundError as e:
+        raise _404(str(e)) from e
+
+
+@router.get(
+    "/{project_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/source/{file_id}",
+    response_model=SourceSlice,
+)
+def read_source(
+    project_id: str,
+    snapshot_id: str,
+    file_id: str,
+    line_start: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    line_end: int | None = Query(default=None),
+    max_lines: int = Query(default=500, ge=1, le=2000),
+) -> SourceSlice:
+    try:
+        snap = get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except SnapshotNotFoundError as e:
+        raise _404(str(e)) from e
+    if snap.project_id != project_id:
+        raise _404("Snapshot not found.")
+    return read_source_lines(
+        snapshot_id=snapshot_id,
+        file_id=file_id,
+        line_start=line_start,
+        line_end=line_end,
+        max_lines=max_lines,
+    )
+
+
+@router.get(
+    "/{project_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/capabilities",
+    response_model=CapabilityReport,
+)
+def read_capabilities(project_id: str, snapshot_id: str) -> CapabilityReport:
+    try:
+        snap = get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except SnapshotNotFoundError as e:
+        raise _404(str(e)) from e
+    if snap.project_id != project_id:
+        raise _404("Snapshot not found.")
+    return build_capability_report(snapshot_id)
+
+
+@router.get(
+    "/{project_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/graph",
+    response_model=Graph,
+)
+def read_graph(
+    project_id: str,
+    snapshot_id: str,
+    max_entities: int = Query(default=250, ge=10, le=500),
+) -> Graph:
+    try:
+        snap = get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except SnapshotNotFoundError as e:
+        raise _404(str(e)) from e
+    if snap.project_id != project_id:
+        raise _404("Snapshot not found.")
+    return build_structural_graph(snapshot_id, max_entities=max_entities)
